summary.text: Kelvin Datcher, a Democrat, has represented District 52 in the Alabama House of Representatives since October 2, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he lost the Democratic primary for re-election on May 19, 2026.

He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Gettysburg College in 1992. His career includes work as director of teaching tolerance at the Southern Poverty Law Center and as deputy director of community development for the City of Birmingham.
